candidate_administration: Two structurally distinct 100-point closed-resource forms, five 20-point domains covering accounting/cash, corporate valuation, investment pricing/allocation, fixed-income/derivative hedging, and institution/governance integration. Consider 300 minutes as an uncalibrated target. Require cross-volume reasoning, complete solutions, a reproducible practical, diagnostic, oral, retention and remediation. No claim that one cumulative test samples every detail of all sixty prerequisite chapters.
